title: Etale neighbourhoods realize finite separable residue field extensions
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $s\in S$, and let $k$ be a finite field extension of the residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] [def-pc-field-extension] which is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there are a scheme $U$, an etale morphism $\varphi:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $u\in U$ with $\varphi(u)=s$ such that the residue field $\kappa(u)$, regarded as an extension of $\kappa(s)$ through the map $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u)$ induced by $\varphi$, is isomorphic to $k$ as an extension of $\kappa(s)$ (there is a field isomorphism $k\to\kappa(u)$ which is the identity on $\kappa(s)$).
